items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: Sam Marlon was in the Rene, Rene's band before I... Sam Marlon came in with East Band

ctx.x: It's called a L-stone. There's a white sort of, uh, plaster. Uh, somewhere off time, like Texas, Louisiana Avenue. And, uh, what was your Planket Dancers then? Hmm? Planket Dancers.

Yeah, they had two bands. One band, they had two yards, though. And they all you are on Drive Street. And they all you are on Ramport. They called it Dania Knots. And we were on the Dania side facing. And, uh, Sam Marlon was in the Rene, Rene's band before I, uh, I, uh, I didn't Rene's band. But, uh, they would be facing Drive Street. And Sam Marlon came in with East Band, and he was facing Drive Street. Uh, that was every Tuesday. Uh, they were choosing that. Besides the old perseverance of the economy of the,…
